title: DNAviWEB: sequencing-free clinical screening of liquid biopsies.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Listed the Zenodo record 19698607 (one 56.9 MB source-code zip) and the GitHub repository tree. Opened the example inputs: electropherogram_meta.csv has 27 samples labelled Control/Treat; image_as_input/Electropherogram_meta.csv has about 30 gel wells (cell lines and organoids, with blank no-template controls). electropherogram.csv is a wide intensity-trace table, one column per sample.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: The neuroblastoma case-study cohort (diagnosis vs relapse) comes from a cited earlier study (ref 34). Its size and where it is deposited are not given in this paper, and its labels are not in the repository. EGA (European Genome-phenome Archive) metadata appears only as a catalogue scheme, not as deposited data.

a1_downloadable.note: Code and example files download from GitHub and Zenodo without a login. No clinical dataset is deposited with the paper.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: The example metadata has a group column (Control/Treat, or cell type), but these are demo groupings, not clinical outcomes.

a3_inputs_present.note: Electropherogram traces (DNA fragment-size intensity profiles) are present as numeric columns.

a4_units_stated.note: Fragment sizes are in base pairs after ladder calibration (bp_translation.csv); concentrations are in pg/µl.

a5_enough_rows.note: The largest example set has 27 samples, the other about 30 wells. That is far below the ~400 needed even for classification. The paper is a web tool, not a dataset.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: The paper gives no dataset counts to compare against.

a8_label_provenance.note: The groups are experimenter-assigned, not model outputs. Moot, because A5 fails.

honest_claim_h3: With 27 demo samples, no model could claim anything beyond separating these specific example groups.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use gel-electrophoresis DNA fragment-size profiles from blood to predict disease status, such as cancer relapse.
plain_idea.train_on: One fragment-size intensity trace per liquid-biopsy sample. Only 27 example samples are public.
plain_idea.predict: Patient group (for example neuroblastoma at diagnosis vs relapse), assigned by clinicians. These labels are not deposited with this paper.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Cheap gel-based screening could triage patients before costly sequencing, but this needs hundreds of labelled clinical profiles that are not released here.

ml_idea: Classify cfDNA (cell-free DNA) gel fragment profiles by disease state. Not feasible: no clinical dataset is released.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count the labelled samples in the repository's example files: 27, so the project fails.

verdict_reason: This is a web-tool paper with no deposited clinical dataset. The only public files are demo electropherograms with 27 and about 30 samples, far below the A5 minimum.
